description:
*"I'm pregnant."
"Jeong-Won, I'm an omega…?"*

Ye Jeong-Won, who has been like a real sibling to Lee Gyeon-Woo since they were young, appears in front of Lee Gyeon-Woo. The two have a one-night stand at a freshman welcome party while drunk, and Jeong-Won reveals that he is pregnant. Gyeon-Woo, an omega, is flustered because he has no memory of that night, but soon comes to his senses and says that he will take responsibility for Jeong-Won and the child. However, Jeong-Won smiles meaningfully when Gyeon-Woo tells him to come into his house. 

*'But hyung, I wish we could be together even if we don't have a child. Because the pregnancy story is a lie.'*

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*
